proposal.summary: Add a new top-level docs/NUSA_GOVERNING_CHARTER.md capturing standing product direction (authority hierarchy, CORE/EVOLVE self-improvement mandate, LIVE approval state machine, P0/P1/P2 priority, UI information architecture), and register its path plus one advisory rules entry in .aipos/aipos.yaml so every agent's mandatory AIPOS recovery reads it.

impact_analysis.analysis: The change adds one paths.governing_charter entry and one rules entry to aipos.yaml. It does not modify docs/NUSA_CORE_ARCHITECTURE_PRINCIPLE.md (the only constitutional_path), does not touch source_of_truth, recovery.protocol, handoff, or architecture_sync blocks, and does not change any governed_paths, protected_boundaries, or lifecycle policy. The new rules entry is explicitly advisory and self-limiting: it states the referenced charter grants no authority and cannot open, widen, or bypass any .aipos/current-mission.yaml serialization gate. No safety, risk, execution, credential, or LIVE-authority code or config path is touched. Net effect is additive metadata only; removing the two added lines fully reverts the file to its pre-change behavior.

migration_plan.compatibility: Additive only. No existing aipos.yaml key is removed, renamed, or reordered in a way that changes meaning; every existing consumer of paths.* or rules[] continues to resolve unchanged.
steps: Add paths.governing_charter to .aipos/aipos.yaml pointing at it.
Add one rules[] entry describing when to read it and its authority limits.
Verify pnpm run validate, architecture:check, aipos:drift, aipos:conformance, safety:invariants, safety:inputs, and pnpm run build all still PASS.

triggers: Any future work order or agent finds the governing_charter path entry or its rules line conflicts with .aipos/current-mission.yaml, an ADR, or a constitutional principle.
procedure: Revert this commit (or delete the paths.governing_charter line and the corresponding rules[] entry from .aipos/aipos.yaml).
Re-run pnpm run validate:full to confirm the repository returns to its pre-change validated state.

criteria: pnpm run validate (preflight, architecture:truth, safety:architecture, ai:architecture)
